747138: The most-booked calanques boat in Marseille by a wide margin — big-boat comfort, a real swim stop, and the reason it tops this table is 1,400+ people saying it delivered.
402096: Top-rated kayak half-day — but note it paddles the Cote Bleue marine park west of Marseille, not the national park. Easier rules, same turquoise water.
471213: Swim-stop boat tour of the Cote Bleue calanques — honest label: that's the OTHER protected coast, not the national park. Pick it when the park side is wind-blown.
887349: Catamaran day with stand-up paddle off the back — the sell-out flag is real in July-August. Book this one ahead; most Marseille boats can't be booked far out.
504626: The Frioul + Chateau d'If combo with swimming — the islands stay open even on red fire-risk days, which makes this the best closure-proof booking in the pool.
434925: Guided hike with picnic at ~$40 — the cheapest way to solve the two things that derail DIY visits: navigation and carrying enough water.
434521: Same operator's core guided hike without the picnic — a fit if you'd rather pack your own lunch and save a few euros.
840629: Sails from Bandol, not Marseille — 13 calanques in 3h15 along the whole Cassis-Marseille coast. Good pick if you're staying east of the park.
395357: Sunset dinner-and-wine sail — this is a sea-view dinner party, not a sightseeing circuit. Judge it as an evening out and it earns its rating.
497075: The buffet-and-wine flagship: a full day at sea with swim stops. At $135 you're paying for hours on the water, not just the route.
643368: Sunset catamaran with buffet and drinks — the budget-friendlier sunset option, and it sells out on summer weekends.
395356: Sailing cruise with lunch and wine under the cliffs — a quieter, slower alternative to the motor circuits; the sell-out flag says book ahead.
67688: An Originals by GetYourGuide e-bike ride to Calanque de Sormiou — the pedal-assist solves the brutal climb back out, which is what stops most walkers.
497128: Top-rated sunset dinner cruise (4.9 over 300+ sailings) — the strongest rating in the sunset category.
839662: The shorter Bandol option — 7 calanques in 2.5 hours. Commentary circuit, no landing anywhere (no boat may land inside the park).
74558: E-bike loop designed around the cruise port — if you're off a ship with 5-6 hours, this is the tightest way to actually see calanques terrain.
499661: Sunset cruise with rose and snacks — cheaper and shorter than the dinner sails; right if the light show matters more than the meal.
754885: Catamaran with picnic and swimming — the daytime sibling of the sunset boats, and one of the fastest-selling tours in this pool.
398570: Swim cruise with optional paddle — runs in French primarily; confident non-French speakers still do fine, the sea needs no translation.
401887: Cassis-side guided hike to three calanques with a swim — the guided answer to En-Vau's steep, polished descent.
639914: Morning cruise to the Frioul calanques with coffee and a swim — small, relaxed, and island-bound, so it survives red-day closures.
737069: Half-day boat into the national park proper with a sell-out flag — one of the few half-day formats that combines the real park coastline with swimming.
388303: Eco-branded (hybrid) boat with lunch and wine — the lower-wake option for the same route; families with seasickness-prone kids report smoother rides.
947171: The premium all-day 'signature' trip with a proper meal — priciest of the day formats; you're buying a full curated day, not a circuit.
914021: Evening sail to the Frioul calanques with buffet — top-rated, and Frioul's lee keeps evening sails running when the open coast is choppy.
497666: Cote Bleue with buffet and wine — same honest label as the other Cote Bleue boats: a different protected coast, west of the city.
68181: E-mountain-bike tour of the park's authorised trail network — legal singletrack access that regular bikes can't manage on these grades.
33237: Certified by GetYourGuide day tour from Aix via Cassis with a Cap Canaille stop — the Route des Cretes viewpoint without driving it yourself.
480835: Private sailing charter to Frioul (price is per group) — the only true private-boat option in the pool with a meaningful review base.
948070: Cassis sea kayaking inside the national park at a perfect 5.0 — guided trips are exempt from the kayak-rental licensing maze; this is the clean way in.
411074: From Aix: Cassis boat ride plus Provence wine tasting — a half-boat, half-vineyard day; the calanques are the appetiser, not the main course.
64341: Full-day guided e-bike from Marseille along the coast into the park — the biggest single-day terrain coverage of any land option here.
943155: La Ciotat's afternoon boat with snorkeling — departs the quieter east gateway; the snorkel stop is a genuine in-water stop, not a viewing pause.
481928: Guided hike from Luminy — the classic Sugiton-side approach with a guide who handles the reservation-season logistics.
411763: E-mountain-bike with a virtual guide (GPS-guided, self-paced) — cheapest legal e-MTB access to the park network if you don't want a group.
1002299: Sailing day to Chateau d'If and the calanques with swimming — history stop plus swim stops on one ticket.
165929: Full-day Bandol and Cassis wine tour — for the day you give the park your morning and Provence's vineyards your afternoon.
439347: Electric motorcycle rental with smartphone guide — a niche but well-reviewed way to cover the corniche; road riding only, not park trails.
1351001: Catamaran to the Frioul islands with swimming and snacks — currently GYG's #1-selling guided tour for Marseille; islands stay open on red days.
1002382: Half-day kayak-plus-hike combo out of Cassis — two access modes in one trip; sells out because group sizes are small.
610215: From Aix: Cassis, Port-Miou and Cap Canaille in one loop — the easiest calanque (Port-Miou's marina fjord) plus France's highest sea cliff.
83472: Certified snorkel-and-scuba day in the park — boat-based diving keeps working on red fire-risk days when every trail is shut.
1018482: La Ciotat's morning snorkel boat at 4.9 — mornings beat afternoons here for glassy water, and the east gateway stays calmer in a mistral.
385834: Cassis sea-kayak tour into the park — guided, so the En-Vau haul-out rules and rental licensing simply aren't your problem.
495676: Stand-up paddle in the park from Cassis at 4.9 — flat-morning conditions required; the operator calls it off rather than sending you into chop.
498306: The couples' pick among the sunset dinner sails — same sea, smaller-feeling boat, 4.9 average.
753669: Catamaran lunch-and-wine day at 4.9 — the highest-rated of the daytime catamaran formats, one tier calmer than the party boats.
75815: Cassis e-MTB ride to calanque viewpoints at 4.9 — viewpoint-focused rather than beach-bound, which honestly suits e-bikes better here.
